summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG across Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored lore destinations; player.state carries progression, gear, quests, faction standing and resume location. Shared player behaviors, generated place simulations and authored dialogue connect these spaces; the Hub's keyed routes include the Tenth Tunnel branch, and Level 1 now links directly back to the Hub.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes, anomalies and generated dressing; cells/objects.scene also places the invisible Bulk Data Manager object.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; authored placements live in cells/.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations, Doorstep Carpet and Camp Amber crews; the west-end Level 1 door and its return marker live in x0z0.scene.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office, supplies, HALOGEN machine, encounters and story beats.
places/level1 (3D) - far-west Level 1 halls and M.E.G. camp; sim builds camp and adds the Hub-arrival marker beside its return door.
places/level9 + places/level11 (3D) - The Suburbs seeded streets and fitted houses; Level 11's Sedco Spotlight/city, Base Beta and generated quest locations.
places/level61 (3D, The Snackrooms) - food court and M.E.G. checkpoint with storefronts, simulated staff/services and Clippers cocktail lounge.
places/level3 + places/level4 + places/level6 (3D) - Guild survey plate, vending-drop survey route and Relay 6-A quest endpoints.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input actions.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and place generation/tick behavior; Level 61 delegates storefront fixtures/services to shared helpers.

scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts + scripts/ui.js - title/settings/pause, character creation and arrival; main-menu drives tutorial beats and lifecycle, tutorial-ui and composed HUD/menus.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player actions/state, wake/resume, aiming, third-person view and HUD zone naming.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + xmas-room.js + level0-moments.js - Level 0 layout and deterministic dressing/encounters.

places/thehub/sim.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + hub-people.js + hub-dress.js + scripts/thehub-geo.js - Hub topology, doors, dressing and crew; Phoebe's fitted NPC uses scripts/lib/phoebe.js and scripts/phoebe-npc.js.
places/level1/sim.js + scripts/level-door.js + scripts/hub-door.js - Level 1 generated camp/arrival marker and threshold routing to/from the Hub.
scripts/lib/level61-quests.js + scripts/talk.js + scripts/quest-marker.js - Level 6.1 cross-level quest definitions, dialogue handling and journal-marker registration.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + preload data/scripts - Bonus shared-room routing, solo IDs, home destinations, labels and proximity preload; distinct from places/thehub.
scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - canonical Hub tunnels, open/keyed/sealed door registry, key inventory and position helpers; shared by geometry, simulation, quests, doors and UI.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - common loot/items and weapon variants; weapon-look selects fitted meshes or scripted geometry.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js + scripts/lib/ui-theme.js - escaping, preference normalization/attributes, Escape handling, empty states, notice toasts and shared dialogue styling.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - parametric doors/motion, paired Level 3 hatches and tagged-seat placement/occupancy helpers.
scripts/lib/data/l9-houses.yml + l9-props.yml + scripts/lib/level9.js - Level 9 house/model/door and prop catalogs plus pure seed-driven layout; consumed by places/level9/sim.js and zone lookup.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js - fitted furniture catalog and common build placement/reconstruction; dining_set composes a table with two offset dining_chair children.

scripts/lib/skill-check.js + scripts/lib/npc-talk.js + scripts/lib/dialogue.js + scripts/lib/data/dlg-*.yml + npc-voices.yml - authored NPC choices/replies, checks and voice mappings reused by talk and quest handlers.
notableExports: scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, hasHalogen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js - STYLE_V, sw194, furrySpec, restyle, restyleQueue, restyleStep, restylePlace; scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, stagger3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands.
scripts/lib/level9.js - HOUSES, ROAD_W, rng, hashStr, yawFacing, layout, zoneAt; places/level9/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/level31-quest.js + level31-parts.js - venue geometry/zones/arrivals/skating/layParts; scripts/lib/ch2-quest.js - CH2 and Chapter 2 quest stage/dialogue handlers.
scripts/lib/level70-quest.js + scripts/terrain70.js - Level 70 quest, terrain and civic/life layer exports.
scripts/lib/errands.js - ERRANDS, held, errandText, offerErrand, payErrand, tryAlt, deliberateErrands, turnInErrand, errandTick; scripts/lib/rep.js - faction and reputation helpers.

scripts/lib/skill-check.js - SKILL_NAMES, parseCheck, checkOdds, formatCheckBanner, resolveCheck; scripts/lib/level61-quests.js - QUESTS61 and quest handlers; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - TRAIL and trail helpers.

scripts/lib/thehub.js - PLACE, door topology and coordinate helpers; scripts/lib/hub-quest.js - hubChoices/handleDialogueQuestHub; scripts/lib/hub-route.js - ROUTE/hubRoute; scripts/lib/hub-people.js - CREW_IDS/layThings/keepCrew/keymaster.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, tapes, currency, karma/rep and homeKeep.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats derived stats.
scripts/critter.js - per-player look and creator/wardrobe/salon state; scripts/lib/seat.js - player.state.sit seating lifecycle; scripts/lib/body3.js - session.ready3 and transient melee-carry pose.
scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - quests/qtrack/qdone/claimed; Dina trail keys, stages, diary/cut/clue fields and legacy migration.

scripts/lib/errands.js - player.state.errands records, errHints and errand journal entries; completion updates currency, payout, reputation and hints; field-errands.js + hub-errands.js own confirmation maps.

scripts/lib/level31-quest.js + level70-quest.js + remodel-quest.js + level11-quests.js + level61-quests.js + ch2-quest.js - level-specific quest stages, routes and rewards; Chapter 2 owns ch2Q/ch2Done and clue, stance and unlock keys.
scripts/lib/level61-quests.js - l61BeeQ/l61SealQ/l61GuildQ/l61SalQ stages and clue/survey/ruling/delivery/outcome flags; level11-quests.js owns craneQ and craneWaybill/craneGuildClear.

scripts/lib/rep.js - faction rep, karma and repHistory; scripts/player.js owns invFilter/invSort and Level ! session fields; scripts/quest-marker.js owns qfilter/qview; scripts/lib/tutorial.js owns player.state.tut.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest and CCTV behaviors; scripts/interact.js handles tagged-seat selection and seatTick.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; body3 tick3 uses camera aim + combat-anims.yml for third-person pose; zoneHere feeds maze/authored zone lookup.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; periodic saves exclude intake, bonus and tutorial0.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to mall/home and maintain roomHop/save-place, separate from places/thehub; fresh visit → main-menu.js.

scripts/main-menu-ui.js settings → scripts/main-menu.js mmenu handler → player.state.uiPrefs; scripts/ui.js wraps composed UI with ui-kit preference attributes; menu actions update menu, inventory filter/sort and journal state.

scripts/player.js writes player.state.notice and scripts/stats.js forwards fresh notices into feed → scripts/ui.js renders ui-kit noticeToast; talk-ui and other panels use shared escaping and ui-theme styling.
scripts/main-menu.js errandTick → scripts/lib/errands.js offers place-matched jobs; carried items/kills/world events advance errands → quests.js journal, player.state.errands/qtrack and payouts.

scripts/talk.js → dialogue.js rootChoices and quest handlers; talk routes through authored dlg-*.yml dialogue and voiceKey mappings, skill checks and journal/feed/reputation helpers; dlg-levels-10-11.yml, chatter.yml and os.yml carry Halliel incident accounts.

scripts/lib/dina-quest.js learns trail clues from talk, diary/cut, HALOGEN tapes and Dina's camp; trailStep/syncHome writes The Way Back journal step and Level 3/5/11 marker targets → scripts/quest-marker.js reads active quest markers.

scripts/main-menu.js arrival → tutStart; update/input call tutTick/tutInput → player.state.tut and tutorial-ui.js card; places/tutorial0/sim.js lays props; tut0-cut.js runs beats and Room D's HALOGEN beat calls dinaLead then advances tutorial state.
scripts/lib/level61-quests.js stages → setStep61/finishQuest61 → shared quest journal, notice/feed, payout and reputation; l61-use.js and Level 3/6 use handlers feed stage changes.

Hub NPC interaction → hub-quest.js choices/handler update Hub quest/key flags; hub-to-l1 and hub-door thresholds → scripts/level-door.js/scripts/hub-door.js → level1#l1-from-hub (marker placed by level1/sim.js); l1-to-hub returns to thehub#hub-from-l1.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon + places/level61/sim.js and scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - authored commercial interiors and simulated staff/services; venue menus and staff vary by shop; Level 6.1 tables use lightweight separately placed setups.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; a dining_set composes a table with two separately fitted chairs.

art/cigs/build.py + art/fnv/build.py and NIF converters → scripts/lib/data/cigs.yml + fnv-props.yml - creator assets become real-scale GLBs; catalogs supply decoration and fitted furniture/props across Levels 5, 9, 11 and 61.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait selection; held crouch initiates crawl, tight ceilings/tunnel mouths trigger automatic crawl; Level ! adds corridor-specific handling.
Level 01/Zenith and Level 1 geometry builders - authored station and car park/service geometry; corridor materials, pipes, fixtures and lights vary deterministically per cell.

scripts/meg-agent.js + npc-temper.js + forgive.js + critter-model.js - NPC reactions, cover, barks, movement/fighting and companion following; faction, role, outfit and assault incidents vary by NPC; Hub Phoebe instead uses phoebe-npc.js with lib/phoebe.js fitted body/outfit.

scripts/lib/level61-quests.js + level11-quests.js + talk/use handlers - quest stages and rewards reuse shared journal/rep/feed helpers and skill-check resolution; scripts/lib/tutorial.js + tut0-cut.js coordinate prompts with timed beats.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. It skips player roots and local-audience objects.
The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs, destinations and coordinates together when changing the shell or thresholds.
The Hub's place.state.hubV gates shell, door and plaque rebuilds; current v9 refreshes modeled doors and plaques for t10-a3 becoming keyed, so new geometry/state migrations must advance the version.

Hub keyed doors consume the matching player.state.hubKeys key; t10-a3 maps to level11 and hubTenthCrossed is set only after a qualifying clue and successful crossing. The Level 1 route is a separate threshold pair, hub-to-l1 → level1#l1-from-hub and l1-to-hub → thehub#hub-from-l1.
Hub Phoebe's generated body/outfit is rebuilt by spawnHubPhoebe's phoebeV; current version is 7, and the fitted outfit supplies its own hair/skirt so cw-hair/cw-botw children are filtered out.

Level 9 keeps l9seed, fog and looted contents across generated rebuilds; motel furniture choice is seed-deterministic, uses furniture.yml dimensions and preserves searchable contents. Weapon mesh offsets/grips also couple weapon-look.js to body3 hand offsets and carry poses.
